name: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building A
summary: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building A is part of one of California's leading outlet shopping destinations, offering premium and designer brands at significant discounts. Located conveniently off Highway 101 in Gilroy, it serves as a major retail draw for Bay Area shoppers seeking exceptional value on name-brand merchandise.
demographics: Gilroy Premium Outlets attracts a diverse mix of bargain-seeking shoppers, including middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center draws heavily from the San Francisco Bay Area, appealing to value-conscious millennials and Gen X shoppers aged 25-54, as well as tourists visiting the region. The trade area extends throughout Silicon Valley and the greater Bay Area, with visitors willing to drive 30-60 minutes for premium brand discounts. Shopping patterns reflect destination-oriented trips with longer dwell times, as customers seek significant savings on designer and name-brand merchandise.
description: Gilroy Premium Outlets - Building A is part of the renowned Gilroy Premium Outlets shopping destination, one of California's premier outlet shopping centers located in the heart of Gilroy. This outlet center has established itself as a major retail destination for Bay Area residents and tourists seeking exceptional value on premium and luxury brands. The center features a carefully curated collection of designer and name-brand outlet stores offering savings of 25% to 65% off retail prices every day. With its convenient location just off Highway 101, approximately 30 miles south of San Jose, the center provides easy access for shoppers throughout the San Francisco Bay Area and Central Coast. The property maintains the high standards expected of the Premium Outlets brand, offering a comfortable open-air shopping environment with ample parking and modern amenities that make it a favorite destination for savvy shoppers looking to maximize their purchasing power.
